_comment: ARC-AGI-1 with bands (2026-10-18), URM recipe where it fits one RTX 4090: data/arc1.npz (ARC-AGI-1 training + evaluation + ConceptARC; test = evaluation test pairs, transductive), on-the-fly augmentation (dihedral x colour permutation of 1..9, translation on training pairs; identifier per task version), 30x30 canvas with EOS, pad ignored. Model: bands (R = 4, eta learned <= 0.125), 8 blocks per segment x 16 segments, hidden 512, 8 heads, FFN expansion 4, task embedding 512 as one prefix token (URM). lr 1e-4, puzzle_emb_lr 1e-2, weight decay 0.1 (URM). Block compile + activation checkpointing for memory. Deviations from URM forced by one GPU and 2.8 GB of free disk: 100 augmented versions per task (URM 1000; the 512-wide table would be 2 GB and be saved twice per checkpoint), batch 32 without gradient accumulation (URM 768 on 8 GPUs), evaluation on the identity version only (no 1000-way voting).
